title: Manage Multiple Resumes the Easy Way
description:
Having to save an entire second, third, or 15th version of your resume just to make small changes is not hard drive or mentally friendly, so try this instead. The Teal Resume Builder is entirely cloud operated and making small changes to your resume is as simple as toggling on or off items you want on that resume version. You can get started by importing your LinkedIn or current resume so check it out now. #resume #resumebuilder #resumetips #resumehelp #resumewriting
